import pandas as pd


def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    df = inputs["readings"].copy()

    # Row-level bad flag: null, negative, or > 1000
    df["is_bad"] = df["value"].isna() | (df["value"] < 0) | (df["value"] > 1000)

    # Per-batch aggregates
    grp = df.groupby("batch_id")
    total_rows = grp["reading_id"].transform("count")
    bad_row_count = grp["is_bad"].transform("sum")

    df["_total_rows"] = total_rows
    df["_bad_row_count"] = bad_row_count

    # Strict >20% quarantine rule
    quarantine_mask = (df["_bad_row_count"] * 100) > (df["_total_rows"] * 20)

    quarantine_df = df[quarantine_mask].copy()
    if len(quarantine_df) > 0:
        quarantine_df["batch_reject_pct"] = (
            quarantine_df["_bad_row_count"] * 100.0 / quarantine_df["_total_rows"]
        ).round(2)
    else:
        quarantine_df["batch_reject_pct"] = pd.Series(dtype="float64")

    non_quarantine = df[~quarantine_mask]

    clean = non_quarantine[~non_quarantine["is_bad"]].copy()
    rejects = non_quarantine[non_quarantine["is_bad"]].copy()

    helper_cols = ["is_bad", "_total_rows", "_bad_row_count"]
    clean = clean.drop(columns=helper_cols).reset_index(drop=True)
    rejects = rejects.drop(columns=helper_cols).reset_index(drop=True)
    quarantine_df = quarantine_df.drop(columns=helper_cols).reset_index(drop=True)

    return {
        "readings_clean": clean,
        "readings_rejects": rejects,
        "readings_quarantine": quarantine_df,
    }
